nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ be a natural number. Every complex root of every polynomial with rational coefficients of degree exactly $n$ is expressible by radicals over $\mathbb{Q}$ if and only if $n \le 4$. Here a complex number is expressible by radicals over $\mathbb{Q}$ when it lies in the smallest subfield $S$ of $\mathbb{C}$ such that $z \in S$ whenever $z \in \mathbb{C}$ and $z^k \in S$ for some integer $k \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Abel–Ruffini theorem

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $E$ be a field extension of $F$, and let $n \ge 5$. If $p \in F[X]$ is irreducible and the Galois group of $p$ over $F$ is isomorphic to the symmetric group $S_n$, then no root of $p$ in $E$ is solvable by radicals over $F$.
nodes.title: Abel–Ruffini, contrapositive form

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and let $E$ be a field extension of $F$. If $p \in F[X]$ is irreducible and the Galois group of $p$ over $F$ is isomorphic to the symmetric group $S_5$, then no root of $p$ in $E$ is solvable by radicals over $F$.
nodes.title: Abel–Ruffini for $S_5$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field of characteristic zero and let $p \in F[X]$ be a nonzero polynomial. Every root of $p$ in an algebraic closure $\overline{F}$ of $F$ is solvable by radicals over $F$ (obtainable from $F$ by field operations and $n$-th roots inside $\overline{F}$) if and only if the Galois group of $p$ over $F$ is solvable.
nodes.title: Solvable extensions ↔ solvable groups
